note: Tome Static renders public paths to static HTML (drush tome:static, --uri important) into tome_static_directory (../html). No config object; directories are settings.php keys and build progress lives in the state keys tome_static.url (last build base URL) and tome_static.building. Permission 'use tome static' gates the UI at /admin/config/tome/static. Extension is via TomeStaticEvents. The medium case reads the live tome_static.url state; the hard case writes it (the value the Generate form persists). Hard cases deliberately do NOT run a full HTML render: on this shared host page rendering is broken by an unrelated contrib module (restrict_ip), and the brief calls for grounding in real state/commands rather than a full site export. Setting the build URL state is a real, isolated, verifiable tome_static operation.

evals.prompt: How do you generate a full static HTML copy of a Drupal site with Tome Static from the command line, and which option must you pass so absolute URLs in the output are correct?
evals.expected_output: Run 'drush tome:static' and pass '--uri=https://your-site.com'. Without --uri Tome warns absolute URLs may be invalid. Output is written to tome_static_directory (default ../html); preview it with 'drush tome:preview'.

evals.prompt: A content editor needs to trigger a Tome Static build from the Drupal admin UI, not the CLI. Which permission do they need and at what admin path is the Generate form?
evals.expected_output: Grant the 'use tome static' permission (restrict access: true). The Generate form is at /admin/config/tome/static/generate (menu root /admin/config/tome/static), alongside Download and Preview.

evals.prompt: Tome Static did not pick up a custom path I want in the static build. Which Tome Static event do I subscribe to in order to add extra paths to the crawl, and which method adds a path?
evals.expected_output: Subscribe to TomeStaticEvents::COLLECT_PATHS ('tome_static.collect_paths') and call CollectPathsEvent::addPath()/addPaths() (you can also replacePath()/deletePath()).

evals.prompt: Tome Static remembers the base URL of the last build on this site. Inspect the live site and report that URL.
evals.expected_output: https://static-live.example.org — stored in the 'tome_static.url' state key (read with 'drush sget tome_static.url').

evals.prompt: Configure Tome Static on this site so that its recorded static-build base URL is exactly https://tome-static-prod.example.com (the value the Generate form persists and later builds default to). Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the 'tome_static.url' state key to https://tome-static-prod.example.com, e.g. 'drush sset tome_static.url https://tome-static-prod.example.com'. This is the StaticGeneratorInterface::STATE_KEY_URL value the Generate form stores.
